description: This file defines the StockStatus controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing stock status entities, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting stock statuses within the admin interface.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations and interface rendering for stock status entities in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the stock status list page, sets up navigation, loads necessary views and data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of stock statuses, primarily delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves stock status data, including pagination, sorting, and links for edit actions; returns the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the display of the form for adding or editing a stock status, including loading language and existing data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to create or update a stock status, performs validation, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected stock statuses, checks for dependencies, and returns JSON with success/error messages.
